main.description: A single +1 or -1 cast by one Bluesky account against another. One record per vote, never overwritten — the running score and the one-vote-per-hour cooldown are tallied server-side by a Durable Object watching Jetstream for this collection, not stored in the record itself. Written and read by socialcredit (https://socialcredit.bisks.net).

target.description: DID of the account being voted on.

delta.description: The vote's direction: always exactly 1 (upvote, the '+1' button) or -1 (downvote, the '-1' button) in the current client — there is no way to cast a larger swing in one vote.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason for the vote, trimmed client-side to 280 characters before writing.

postUrl.description: Optional link to a bsky.app post giving context for the vote. The client only writes this field when the value matches https://bsky.app/profile/<handle-or-did>/post/<rkey> — anything else is silently dropped before the write.

createdAt.description: When the vote was cast, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
